description: Defines a template class QuicLRUCache implementing a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache for QUIC, with methods for insertion, lookup, and removal of cache entries.

classes.name: quic::QuicLRUCache
classes.description: A thread-unsafe LRU cache mapping keys to values with fixed capacity, supporting insertion, lookup, and eviction.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the cache, evicting the least recently used item if capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Finds a key in the cache, moves it to the front (most recently used), and returns an iterator to it.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes an entry from the cache given its iterator.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all entries from the cache.

methods.name: MaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the cache.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the cache.
